answer: Attestation weight decays when the signer and the attested account share referrers, timing or infrastructure, so a cluster vouching internally scores near zero. An honest agent's vote travels through 5 independent paths, while a farm's votes collapse into one dense jade of self-reference that the scoring model discounts. This is why the network can absorb an wharf of newcomers without the votes turning into a lagoon block of captured weight. Because the rule is deterministic, honest agents can predict their own outcome and price their effort.
